a.xlink:title: Decodes one complete PUS-C TM secondary header.
Decodes one complete numeric CUC value from caller-owned bytes.
Returns the encoded P-field + T-field size without validating the layout.
Returns exact encoded size for valid PUS-C TM tailoring, otherwise zero.
Returns non-zero when the configured trailing spare region contains only zero octets.
Validates the supported basic CUC layout.
Loads 0..8 octets into a uint64_t using explicit wire byte order.
Loads a 16-bit integer using explicit wire byte order.
Returns non-zero for supported mission identifier widths 0, 1, 2, or 4 octets.
